text:
两件能合成的道具在棋盘上贴着放，接缝上会浮出一枚小锤。点它先看一眼要用掉哪两件、合出什么（没合成过也没见过的成品是问号），按「合成」才合：两件消失，成品落在两件原来的格子里。放不下自动找位，再不行到{zone:地上}。

锁着的、随身之物不会被合掉。合成只在一局里发生。

texts.en:
Put two items that combine next to each other on the board and a small hammer appears on the seam. Click it to see which two items will be used and what they make (a result you have never made or seen shows as a question mark), then press Fuse. Both items disappear and the result takes their cells. If it doesn't fit, it finds a spot automatically; failing that, it goes to the {zone:地上}.

Locked and pinned items are never used up. Crafting only happens during a run.
